fee_notes: Standard single-center Initial Franchise Fee is $19,900, uniform for all new franchisees. Veterans (honorably discharged, DD214 required) receive a 15% discount for their first Center only, reducing the fee to $16,915. Under the Market Accelerator / Step Up Program, each additional Center beyond the first is $14,900 (a $5,000 discount). Existing franchisees signing for a 'Box within a Box' location pay $14,900; new franchisees in that program pay $19,900. Fee is nonrefundable and payable in full at signing. Additional required fees at opening include: $20,000 minimum grand opening marketing (including $3,000 payable to franchisor); Equipment and Inventory Package $39,800–$41,700 (including $25,000 purchased from franchisor); shipping/handling $1,750–$3,000; onboarding personal training services $500 for first Center, $200 per additional Center.
raw_excerpt: If you are acquiring franchise rights for a new, single Center, the Initial Franchise Fee is $19,900. ... If you are a veteran or a former member of the U.S. Armed Forces and were honorably discharged (you must provide us with a copy of your DD214), we will reduce your Initial Franchise Fee for your first Center only by fifteen percent (15%) for an Initial Franchise Fee of $16,915 for your first Center ("Veteran Discount"). ... the total Initial Franchise Fee for the second Center, and for each additional Center, is $14,900 (a discount of $5,000 for each Center). ... If you are an existing Franchisee signing a Franchise Agreement for a single Center contained within the big box fitness facility, you will pay us an Initial Franchisee Fee of $14,900.
